### Module(s)

mini.surround

### Description

Similar to `MiniSurround.gen_spec.input.treesitter` have a function that does so for regular parenthesis.

For example:
```lua
local function ts_input(captures)                                                     
  local left = captures.left
  local right = captures.right

  return function()                                                                     
    local node = vim.treesitter.get_node()                                              
                                                                                        
    while node do                                                                       
      local srow, scol, erow, ecol = node:range()                                       
      local first = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_text(0, srow, scol, srow, scol + #left, {})[1] 
      local last = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_text(0, erow, ecol - #right, erow, ecol, {})[1] 

      if first == left and last == right then                                           
        return {{                                                                       
          left = {                                                                      
            from = { line = srow + 1, col = scol + 1 },                                 
            to = { line = srow + 1, col = scol + #left },                               
          },                                                                            
          right = {                                                                     
            from = { line = erow + 1, col = ecol - #right + 1 },                        
            to = { line = erow + 1, col = ecol },                                       
          },                                                                            
        }}                                                                              
      end                                                                               
      node = node:parent()                                                              
    end                                                                                 
                                                                                        
    return {}                                                                           
  end                                                                                   
end                                                                                     
```

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the suggestion!

I think this is a bit too much to be included directly in 'mini.surround'. Not in the last place because it most certainly won't be robust enough for all languages due relying on queries.
